messages.author: Demian Riccardi
messages.body:
Hello,
I'm trying to build amber using cuda 11.1, but it looks like the supported
range is between 7.5 and 11.0. Do I need to downgrade?
-- CUDA version 11.1 detected
CMake Error at cmake/CudaConfig.cmake:74 (message):
Error: Unsupported CUDA version. AMBER requires CUDA version >= 7.5 and
<=
11.0.
Please upgrade your CUDA installation or disable building with CUDA.
